title: Under a base manifest identity both manifests must be DSSE-signed by it (else E-provider-missing, never invalid); commits must hash to their revisions and name the manifest's tree (else invalid); an identity added in the head acts after merge

assert.why: A.5.2.17: both manifests are DSSE-signed by the identity the base shape names; commits verify (A.16.1(d))
A.10.1: E-provider-missing is an input-integrity error, which blocks; it is not invalid (A.5.2.17)
A.5.2.17 [D27]: the head manifest is a bare statement; A.15.1, A.16.25: subject manifest
the base manifest is signed by the identity; nothing else is wrong
A.5.2.17: a manifest signed by a key other than the base manifest identity is E-provider-missing
A.6.1.2, A.12.7.5, A.16.1(d): the head commit hashes to head.revision but its tree line names a tree other than the one rebuilt from the head manifest
A.6.1.2, A.16.1(d): head.revision is not the SHA-1 of the head commit object
A.5.2.17, A.6.2.6: the manifest identity is read from the base, which names none, so unsigned manifests are only unauthenticated (health)
A.8.2.3 L7: undecided iff the manifest identity changed; A.5.2.17: a head edit of the field is an L7 question acting after merge; A.8.3.2: L7 is never exploited
A.7.5.1 rule 9: the shape subject is critical (A.8.2.2) and Gate critical blocks latent loosening
